## 变更 / Change

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior. 说明具体问题与改后行为。

## 验证 / Validation

List relevant checks and distinguish host/static evidence from Android execution. 列出相关检查及实际设备边界。

## 同步资料 / Synchronized documentation

- [ ] Chinese and English READMEs/guides updated where affected / 双语文档已同步
- [ ] CHANGELOG and version notes updated / 更新说明已同步
- [ ] Affected screenshots/GIFs refreshed, with demo scope retained / 相关媒体已更新并保留演示标识
- [ ] No secrets, signing material, weights, caches, or browser profiles / 无敏感文件
